name: Harbor

nodes.label: Harbor
nodes.detail: Harbor, the sample team workspace. Pages below are the surfaces of this app.

nodes.label: Landing
nodes.detail: Public marketing page. Get started goes to Login. View pricing goes to Checkout.

nodes.label: Hero
nodes.detail: The landing headline and short description of Harbor.

nodes.label: Get started
nodes.detail: Sends a new visitor to the login page.

nodes.label: View pricing
nodes.detail: Opens checkout so a visitor can compare plans.

nodes.label: Login
nodes.detail: Signs the user in with a password or GitHub, then opens the dashboard.

nodes.label: Login form
nodes.detail: Email and password form. A 401 stays on this page.

nodes.label: Sign in
nodes.detail: Submits the login form to POST /api/login.

nodes.label: Continue with GitHub
nodes.detail: Starts GitHub OAuth and returns the user to Harbor with a session.

nodes.label: Dashboard
nodes.detail: Home for a signed-in user. Navigation opens Projects, Profile, and Settings.

nodes.label: Navigation
nodes.detail: Links to the main areas of the signed-in app.

nodes.label: Recent activity
nodes.detail: Shows the latest project changes for the signed-in user.

nodes.label: Profile menu
nodes.detail: Account menu in the dashboard header.

nodes.label: Open projects
nodes.detail: Navigates from the dashboard to the projects page.

nodes.label: Open profile
nodes.detail: Navigates from the dashboard to the profile page.

nodes.label: Open settings
nodes.detail: Navigates from the dashboard to settings.

nodes.label: Projects
nodes.detail: Lists the workspace projects. Create Project starts a new one.

nodes.label: Search
nodes.detail: Filters the project list by name.

nodes.label: Search projects
nodes.detail: Calls GET /api/projects with the current query.

nodes.label: Project list
nodes.detail: Renders the projects returned by GET /api/projects.

nodes.label: Project card
nodes.detail: One project in the list. Summarize asks OpenAI for a short description.

nodes.label: Create Project
nodes.detail: Posts the new project name to POST /api/projects.

nodes.label: Summarize
nodes.detail: Asks the API to summarize one project with OpenAI.

nodes.label: Profile
nodes.detail: The signed-in user's name and avatar.

nodes.label: Profile form
nodes.detail: Edits the display name stored on the users table.

nodes.label: Save profile
nodes.detail: Patches /api/me with the new name.

nodes.label: Upload avatar
nodes.detail: Stores the avatar file in Amazon S3.

nodes.label: Settings
nodes.detail: Workspace preferences. Upgrade plan opens checkout.

nodes.label: Save settings
nodes.detail: Patches /api/settings for the signed-in user.

nodes.label: Upgrade plan
nodes.detail: Navigates to checkout to start a subscription.

nodes.label: Checkout
nodes.detail: Subscription checkout. Subscribe charges Stripe and records the plan.

nodes.label: Plan picker
nodes.detail: Chooses the Harbor plan sent to checkout.

nodes.label: Payment form
nodes.detail: Collects the card that CheckoutService sends to Stripe.

nodes.label: Subscribe
nodes.detail: Posts the chosen plan to POST /api/checkout.

nodes.label: POST /api/login
nodes.detail: Password login. Handled by AuthService. A bad password raises Invalid credentials.

nodes.label: POST /api/auth/github
nodes.detail: Builds the GitHub OAuth URL and, after the callback, opens a session.

nodes.label: POST /api/projects
nodes.detail: Creates a project. Authentication is required before ProjectController runs.

nodes.label: GET /api/projects
nodes.detail: Returns the signed-in user's projects. Authentication is required.

nodes.label: POST /api/projects/:id/summary
nodes.detail: Summarizes one project. Authentication is required. The text comes from OpenAI.

nodes.label: PATCH /api/me
nodes.detail: Updates the signed-in user's profile. Authentication is required.

nodes.label: POST /api/me/avatar
nodes.detail: Accepts an avatar upload. Authentication is required. The object is stored in S3.

nodes.label: PATCH /api/settings
nodes.detail: Saves workspace settings for the signed-in user. Authentication is required.

nodes.label: POST /api/checkout
nodes.detail: Starts a subscription. Authentication is required. Payment goes to Stripe.

nodes.label: Require auth
nodes.detail: Rejects the request with 401 unless the session cookie belongs to a user.

nodes.label: Session
nodes.detail: The session created at login. Presenting it is what opens the dashboard.

nodes.label: AuthService
nodes.detail: Checks the password, talks to GitHub for OAuth, and creates a session.

nodes.label: ProjectService
nodes.detail: Business logic for creating, listing, and summarizing projects.

nodes.label: CheckoutService
nodes.detail: Starts a subscription and records it after Stripe accepts the payment.

nodes.label: UserService
nodes.detail: Updates the user profile and stores avatar objects.

nodes.label: AuthService.login()
nodes.detail: Reads the users table and, on success, creates a session.

nodes.label: AuthService.createSession()
nodes.detail: Inserts a row in sessions and returns the id written into the cookie.

nodes.label: ProjectController.create
nodes.detail: The create action on ProjectController. It delegates to ProjectService.

nodes.label: ProjectController.list
nodes.detail: The list action on ProjectController.

nodes.label: ProjectService.create()
nodes.detail: Inserts a project row. A duplicate slug raises Duplicate project name.

nodes.label: ProjectService.list()
nodes.detail: Reads projects matching the search query.

nodes.label: ProjectService.summarize()
nodes.detail: Reads the project and asks OpenAI for a short summary.

nodes.label: CheckoutService.createSubscription()
nodes.detail: Sends the payment to Stripe and writes the subscriptions row.

nodes.label: UserService.updateProfile()
nodes.detail: Writes the user's name on the users table.

nodes.label: UserService.storeAvatar()
nodes.detail: Puts the avatar object in the harbor-avatars S3 bucket.

nodes.label: PostgreSQL
nodes.detail: Harbor's relational database. Open it to see tables and which columns reference each other.

nodes.label: users
nodes.detail: Accounts. Sessions, projects, memberships, and subscriptions all reference this table.

nodes.label: sessions
nodes.detail: Server-side sessions written by AuthService.createSession().

nodes.label: projects
nodes.detail: One row per Harbor project. Written by ProjectService.create().

nodes.label: project_members
nodes.detail: Joins users to projects.

nodes.label: subscriptions
nodes.detail: The plan and Stripe ids for a paying workspace.

nodes.label: Stripe
nodes.detail: CheckoutService.createSubscription() creates the Stripe subscription and stores its id.

nodes.label: GitHub
nodes.detail: Continue with GitHub sends the user to GitHub and back into AuthService.

nodes.label: OpenAI
nodes.detail: ProjectService.summarize() calls the OpenAI chat completions API.

nodes.label: Amazon S3
nodes.detail: UserService.storeAvatar() puts objects in the harbor-avatars bucket.

nodes.label: Invalid credentials
nodes.detail: AuthService.login() rejects an unknown email or a bad password. The login form stays put.

nodes.label: Duplicate project name
nodes.detail: ProjectService.create() refuses a slug that is already in projects.

metadata.errorMessage: A project with that name already exists.

nodes.label: Payment declined
nodes.detail: Stripe did not accept the card. No subscriptions row is written.

nodes.label: src/components/CreateProjectButton.tsx
nodes.detail: The Create Project button and the POST it fires.

nodes.label: src/controllers/ProjectController.ts
nodes.detail: ProjectController create and list actions.

nodes.label: src/services/project.ts
nodes.detail: ProjectService, including create(), list(), and summarize().

nodes.label: src/services/auth.ts
nodes.detail: AuthService login and session creation.

nodes.label: src/services/checkout.ts
nodes.detail: CheckoutService and the Stripe call.

nodes.label: src/middleware/requireAuth.ts
nodes.detail: The middleware that protects signed-in APIs.

flows.label: Sign in
flows.description: Landing leads to Login. The password form calls AuthService, writes a session, and opens the dashboard.

flows.label: Create a project
flows.description: From Projects, Create Project calls POST /api/projects, passes Require auth, and ProjectService.create() writes the projects table.

flows.label: Subscribe
flows.description: Settings opens Checkout. Subscribe calls CheckoutService, which writes subscriptions and sends the payment to Stripe.

flows.label: Browse projects
flows.description: The project list queries GET /api/projects, which reads the projects table after Require auth.

flows.label: Continue with GitHub
flows.description: Login sends the user to GitHub OAuth and back into a Harbor session on the dashboard.

description: Team project workspace. Sample graph for the WorkFlow map.
